alert.title: Action required
alert.paragraph1: Apple now requires your iOS app to be linked to your own Apple Developer account (not bsport's). To keep your app live and allow future updates, you must complete this setup <0>before May 31 2026.</0>
alert.paragraph2: Follow the step-by-step instructions in our <0>playbook</0>.
alert.paragraph3: If you need help, contact our support team at <0>support@bsport.io</0>.
